name: Javier Sepúlveda
bio: Javier's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, fueled by watching the Dakar Rally traverse the Atacama Desert. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduating, he started as a junior engineer at a local racing team before quickly rising through the ranks due to his sharp analytical skills and dedication. Javier's approach as a sporting director is rooted in data-driven decision-making, combined with a talent for nurturing talent within the team. His ability to translate complex technical information into actionable strategies sets him apart.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Javier is of average height with a focused gaze and a confident posture.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct meetings while walking, believing it stimulates creativity.
